This document outlines the inspection and minor maintenance procedures P1, to be 
performed every six-months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

These activities are performed by station
maintenance staff and would also be performed at this time.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category

Personnel carrying out the maintenance should be
trained and qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc.

The CB must be isolated and properly earthed at both
sides, it should be in ON position.
Disconnect DC voltage.
Use only fiberglass ladder.

Do not throw any oil into
the sewage because the oil prevents the sewage treatment process.

Collect the oil that
drained out of the poles into a barrel and return it back to the vendor to
recycle it to save money.

Collect the oil used in
washing the poles in another barrel and do not re-use it for filling the poles
unless filtered, dried and its dielectric strength measured with an oil tester
(not less than 40 kV / 2.5 mm).

Don't burn cloth used in cleaning but collect it and send it to the 
 dump.

One set of open-end
wrenches.

One set of screwdrivers,
Torque wrench.

Fine emery cloth,
Some of clean and dry
cloth.

Benzene and Grease,
One barrel of new oil.
The special tools of CB.

Tin cans to hold bolts,
nuts, studs, washers, etc.

sections.text: Inspection of Fixed and Moving Contacts

items:
Open
 the drainage oil- plug to drain the oil out of the CB in a suitable
 container.

Unscrew
 the 11 screws of the upper cover (1 fig.1) of the arcing chamber and pull it
 up.

Unscrew
 the 4 screws that fix the fixed contact to the arcing chamber (1 fig.2)
 using socket wrench 14 with long arm.

Pull
 the fixed contact up.

Inspect
 the fixed contact segments, if it is in a good condition it means that the
 moving contact is probably also in a good condition.

If
 its segments are slightly burnt it should be cleaned by a fine emery cloth.

If
 it is burnt with punctures it means that both of the moving contact and
 fixed contact are in a bad condition their contact surface should be changed
 and overhaul maintenance may be made to the arcing chamber. (Refer to MPIS
 overhaul maintenance document for this CB).

Clean
 the fixed contact with benzene and new oil.

sections.text: Inspection of the Came Oil Seal

Check
for any oil leakage around the came and if there is leakage of oil, the came oil
seal has to be changed as follows:

items:
Remove
 the cotter pin of the pin which fixing the came to the connecting rode
 (2fig.1) and pull the pin out.

Release
 the connecting rode (3 fig.1) down to the ground, and take care not to
 damage the porcelain of connecting rode.

Unscrew
 the screw that fixing the came to the came shaft (4 fig.1). 
 Use spanner 14

Unscrew
 the 4 screws that fixing the flange of the came to the CB (2fig.3).Use
 spanner 19

Pullout
 the came with its flange using special clamp (fig. 4), (3 fig. 2).

Pull
 out the old oil seal and clean its seat with benzene and fine emery cloth
 and lubricate it, and replace the old oil seal with new one.

Clean
 the came shaft using fine emery cloth and lubricate it.

Reassemble
 the came with its flange to its previous position using special tool 
 (fig.5), (4 fig.2).

Screw
 in the oil drainage plug again and refill the arcing chamber with new oil
 and drain it for cleaning.

Reassemble
 the upper cover of the arcing chamber to its original position and open the
 refilling oil plug to refill the CB with new oil.

Close
 and open the Breaker two times and drain the oil out again from oil drainage
 plug to ensure complete cleaning of the arcing chamber.

Refill
 the CB with new oil to a proper level.

Perform
 timing test before putting the CB in service and record all that have been
 done in the maintenance card.

Introduction
This document outlines the inspection and minor maintenance procedures P1, to be 
performed every six-months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
These activities are performed by station
maintenance staff and would also be performed at this time.
Safety Precaution
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Personnel carrying out the maintenance should be
trained and qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc.
The CB must be isolated and properly earthed at both
sides, it should be in ON position.
Disconnect DC voltage.
Use only fiberglass ladder.
Environmental Recommendations
Do not throw any oil into
the sewage because the oil prevents the sewage treatment process.

drained out of the poles into a barrel and return it back to the vendor to
recycle it to save money.

washing the poles in another barrel and do not re-use it for filling the poles
unless filtered, dried and its dielectric strength measured with an oil tester

Don't burn cloth used in cleaning but collect it and send it to the 
 dump.

Inspect

If

If

Pull
